name: numeric-conversion-test-6b3e1e5e00/out-of-range-negative-decimal-as-int-p.bal
reason: The case requires a negative decimal literal and an explicit decimal-to-int cast to panic when the value is below the int range. Numeric literals, unary minus, local declarations, calls and type casts are positively supported, with no applicable restriction excluding out-of-range numeric conversion behavior.
test_design_notes: The expected panic is marked by the inline // @panic comment; the program does not catch or inspect the panic.
